versions.title: Boards Tab & Smarter Updates
changes: 📋 New Boards tab — jump straight to any board across all your groups in one tap
🔔 Alerts moved to top header — bottom nav is now cleaner with Home, Explore, Messages, Boards, Profile
⚡ Instant updates — app now reloads automatically when a new version is available, no more stale screens
🖼 Board covers — board cards now show cover images with correct layout and styling

versions.title: Smoother Feel & PWA Polish
changes: ✨ Instant loading — pages appear from cache immediately with shimmer skeleton screens while content loads
👆 Tap feedback — every button subtly presses in when you tap it, with light haptic vibration on key actions
👈 Swipe-back handle — swipe right from the left edge to go back; a glowing handle tracks your finger in real time
🔖 App shortcuts — long-press the home screen icon to jump straight to Dashboard, Messages, Explore or your Profile
🗺 Better install quality — fixed app icon purpose metadata so your installed icon looks crisp on every launcher

versions.title: Explore, Member Profiles & Collections
changes: 🔍 Explore tab — discover hot posts from your groups and search members & content
👤 Clickable member profiles — tap any author name to view their posts and collections
🗂 Save to Collection — bookmark your favourite posts into personal collections via long-press
🔗 Link preview cards — URLs in post captions automatically show rich previews with title and thumbnail

versions.title: Performance & Reliability
changes: ⚡ Faster load times — deferred scripts and service worker caching improvements
🖼 Board cover image upload in the admin panel
🔁 Smarter group loading — in-page error with Retry instead of alert redirects
